name: insightark-skills
description: InsightArk workflow skills and hosted MCP for SUPER 8 Studio CRM operations. After install, run /plugin configure to set S8_SESSION_TOKEN (Console → Account Settings → InsightArk MCP → Create token).

S8_SESSION_TOKEN.title: Session token
S8_SESSION_TOKEN.description: InsightArk MCP session token (starts with r:). Create one in Console → Account Settings → InsightArk MCP → Create token. URLs: https://console.no8.io (prod) / https://stage-console.no8.io (staging).
